scenes.name: god_devotion
scenes.reason: the god's ring, where its offerings are
scenes.story: El Secreto made the chained god the Zócalo's Patron, and the faithful keep it fed: they kneel at its offerings while a warden swings copal.

scenes.name: god_press
scenes.reason: the god's ring, where its offerings are
scenes.story: The papers never tire of the god: a press photographer at his tripod, two reporters calling questions, a gendarme keeping the cage.

scenes.name: preacher
scenes.reason: the god's ring, where its offerings are
scenes.story: The Calles Law silenced the churches, so the priest preaches in the square, on a soapbox under the god he damns; a few listen, one heckles.

scenes.name: evangelistas
scenes.story: Under Santo Domingo's arcade the public letter-writers type for those who cannot: love, debts, petitions to the Inquisition's heirs.

scenes.name: monster_wagon
scenes.story: The canal came back and brought the ahuízotl with it: caught, tanked and shown for a centavo, its barker on his box, a ring of faces, a child held up to see.

scenes.name: market_hall
scenes.story: The market hall's doors: carts nose to tail either side, porters with baskets, shoppers, the dogs that follow the tamales.

scenes.name: market_hall_night
scenes.story: After dark the carts are covered and chained at the hall's doors; the watchman sleeps against the wall, his lantern by him.

scenes.name: flower_row
scenes.story: Before the hall the flower sellers stand together, cempasúchil heaped for the dead, buckets of it at their feet.

scenes.name: firewood_landing
scenes.reason: the canal landing, where boats come in
scenes.story: Firewood comes up from the canal by canoe and is stacked on the quay; porters carry it up from the landing.

scenes.name: line_of_the_dead

scenes.name: line_of_the_dead_night
